title: ChromaDb add single document, only if it doesn't exist
answer:
You can use the `add_document` method of the `Chroma` class, which allows you to add a single document to the vector store. This method checks if the document already exists in the vector store before adding it. If the document does not exist, it will be added with the specified embeddings. Here is an example of how to use this method:

```python
from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings

# Initialize the Chroma vector store
db = Chroma.from_documents([], embeddings=OpenAIEmbeddings(), persist_directory='db')

# Add a single document to the vector store
document = Document(page_content='foo', metadata={'baz': 'bar'})
db.add_document(document=document, id='1')
```

This will add the document to the vector store only if it does not already exist. If the document already exists, it will not be added again.
